annotations.title: 株式会社インテルゲート｜intelgate,Inc.
InvGate - Build a state-of-the-art IT operation

content.text:
“**IntelGate**” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:

1. **A Japanese IT company — Intelgate, Inc.**  
   A Tokyo-based company that provides internet/content planning, production, operations, maintenance, advertising, marketing, and consulting services. Its name combines “Intel” from the Italian word for internet and “gate” as an entry point to internet business. ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

2. **A term for a U.S. political/intelligence controversy**  
   “Intelgate” has been used to describe alleged manipulation of U.S. CENTCOM intelligence analysis about the wars in Syria and Iraq, beginning around 2015. ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

3. **A software/digital solutions company called INTELGATE**  
   There is also an INTELGATE listed on LinkedIn as a small software and digital solutions company based in Gazimağusa / Famagusta, Northern Cyprus, founded in 2017. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

4. **Possibly a misspelling of “InvGate”**  
   If you saw it in an IT-service-management or asset-management context, you may mean **InvGate**, a company offering ITSM and IT asset management software. ([invgate.com](https://invgate.com/?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me where you saw “IntelGate” — politics, cybersecurity, software, a product label, etc. — I can pin down the exact meaning.
